content.user_title: Update Google Business Profile Holiday Hours
content.value_statement: Incorrect holiday hours can mislead customers about when your business opens. This skill guides Reach previews, individual approvals, and publication checks for Google Business Profile updates.
actual_capabilities: Select a connected business location and read its regular hours, special hours, and address country.
Suggest upcoming public holidays from model knowledge and ask the owner to verify dates and choose business hours.
Build a full special-hours list that retains existing entries, within the 60-entry limit.
Preview each date change and surface invalid fields or separately staged dashboard edits.
Publish only approved changes using preview references and idempotency keys, with another preview after a conflicting listing change.
Read back the listing and report applied, skipped, failed, or delayed updates.
limitations: Requires the hosted Reach MCP server, browser OAuth, and an active Google Business Profile connection for writes.
Reach provides no holiday-calendar tool; suggested dates come from model knowledge and require owner verification.
Special hours allow at most 60 entries, and updates count toward 20 Google writes per hour per business.
Google publication can be delayed, and Reach plan restrictions or rate limits can prevent updates.

use_cases.title: Plan retail holiday closures
use_cases.description: Review upcoming holidays for a shop and approve each closure before it is published on Google.

use_cases.title: Adjust restaurant holiday service
use_cases.description: Preview shorter holiday service hours while preserving previously scheduled special hours.

use_cases.title: Maintain a selected client location
use_cases.description: Choose the correct connected location, collect explicit owner approvals, and report the returned publication outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Review upcoming holidays
prompt_templates.prompt: Use holiday-hours to show upcoming public holidays for my business location. Ask which dates need different hours before preparing updates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: identify dates without changing the listing.

prompt_templates.title: Preview one closure
prompt_templates.prompt: For [location], preview closing on [date]. Preserve existing special hours and wait for my explicit approval before publishing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a single holiday closure.

prompt_templates.title: Set reduced opening hours
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview [location] opening from [open time] to [close time] on [date]. Show before and after, and separate staged edits for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review custom opening times and unrelated staged changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review several holiday changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [holiday dates] for [location], one date at a time. Preserve existing entries, request separate approvals, and report conflicts or publication delays.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: manage several changes with individual approval and verification.

output_examples.input: Preview closing my shop on a holiday date I confirmed.
output: Do you approve closing on this exact date? No update has been published.

output_examples.input: I approved reduced holiday hours, but the listing still shows the old hours.
output: Illustrative result: The write reports this date as applied, with no skipped or failed changes.
The listing read-back still shows the previous hours.
Google may still be applying the update. The new hours are not yet verified in the read-back.

best_practices: Confirm the business location, country, holiday date, and intended hours before approving a preview.
Preserve existing special hours and approve staged dashboard edits separately.
Review returned publication outcomes and read-back values without claiming immediate Google publication.
anti_patterns: Assuming every public holiday means the business is closed.
Treating one approval as permission to publish several holiday changes.
Replacing the special-hours list without retaining existing entries.

faq.question: What must I connect before using this skill?
faq.answer: Connect the Reach MCP server in your AI client and sign in through browser OAuth. Writes require an active Google Business Profile connection.

faq.question: Does the skill use an official holiday calendar?
faq.answer: No. Reach has no holiday-calendar tool. The skill suggests dates from model knowledge and asks the owner to correct them.

faq.question: Can it publish without my approval?
faq.answer: The instructions require an explicit yes for the exact date and hours after a preview. Each additional holiday needs separate approval.

faq.question: Will existing special hours be preserved?
faq.answer: The workflow includes existing entries in the full special-hours list. The list can contain at most 60 entries.

faq.question: Why might an approved update not appear immediately?
faq.answer: Google may still be applying it. The skill reports returned outcomes and checks the listing without claiming unverified publication.

faq.question: What happens when Reach refuses an update?
faq.answer: The workflow reports rate limits or plan restrictions and stops or waits as instructed. A conflicting listing change requires another preview.
